name: Earshot
summary: Care coordination for a device the whole room can hear.

icons.note: Light-theme icons are the dark tile, for display on light surfaces; dark-theme icons are the near-white tile. All opaque, full-bleed, safe under any rounded mask.

carousel.alt: Earshot for Alexa+. The Echo says out loud: “I can’t put that one in the room. It’s on your phone.” Below it, the private card on the asker’s own phone showing medication, dose and diagnosis. Protected values spoken aloud: 0.
